_about: Logit-bias arms for bench-thinking.ps1. Words are resolved to the tested model's own token ids at run time. Forms: 'leading-space' is the word after a space (' wait'), 'line-start' is the word opening a line ('Wait' after a newline); these are different tokens. A form that tokenizes to more than one token is skipped, because biasing its first piece would hit unrelated words.

paper.about: The 50 overthinking markers of arXiv 2606.00206, leading-space form only, as in the r/LocalLLaMA post. On Qwen3.x 'recheck' is two tokens, leaving 49. Covers 'or', 'but', 'error', which also occur in code and tool-call JSON.

narrow.about: Only wait / hmm / actually, in both forms. On Qwen3.x line-start 'hmm' is two tokens, leaving 11.
